title: PaymentAttempt
description: Canonical event schema for a single payment attempt in the Payment Retry Sequencer project. Every phase (data generator, classifier, policy engine, API) reads and writes records matching this shape.

transaction_id.description: Unique identifier for this specific attempt.

customer_id.description: Hashed/synthetic customer identifier. Never real PII.

amount.description: Transaction amount in the smallest currency unit is optional; keep it in whole rupees for simplicity.

currency.description: Fixed to INR for this project's scope.

gateway.description: Name of the payment gateway used for this attempt, e.g. 'gateway_a', 'gateway_b'. Keep synthetic/generic names, not real vendor names.

bank_response_code.description: Raw, noisy response code as if received from the bank/gateway. This is the noisy signal the classifier learns to interpret.

decline_reason_category.description: The TRUE underlying reason category. In the raw production case this would be inferred; in the synthetic dataset it is generated as ground truth, then partially obscured before being handed to the classifier.

attempt_number.description: 1 for the original attempt, incrementing for each retry of the same underlying transaction.

is_recurring.description: True if this attempt is part of a subscription/mandate rather than a one-off checkout.

previous_attempts.description: History of prior attempts for the same underlying transaction, oldest first. Empty for attempt_number == 1.

retry_action_taken.description: The action the policy engine chose for this attempt. Null if not yet evaluated.

retry_outcome.description: Outcome of the retry action, once known. Null until resolved.

time_to_recovery.description: Seconds from the original failure to successful recovery. Null if never recovered.
